spec: Share pure movement destination plans between controller legality and future AI enumeration. Walks validate the complete weighted path before spending, consume a positive power allowance once, and reject illegal repeated, blocked or rooted movement. AoO hits cancel the entire pending move.
expect: Two authored positive-budget movements execute their advertised distances in real battles. Weighted costs, zero-step Root exception, malformed paths, no-spend rejection and mid-move interruption have concrete tests. Existing controls remain unchanged; newly registered scenarios compare automatic, suspended and restored drivers.
note: The old command test explicitly preserved a known positive-budget clamp; it now asserts successful full execution. Historical cursor golden files remain unchanged; new scenarios compare current drivers rather than claim nonexistent historical hashes. Snapshot rules version advances because movement execution semantics changed. AI scoring/routing, slot interchangeability and Surge refresh remain separate items.
